answer: Use rotating paired accountability against sybils: each epoch, every identity is randomly paired with a stranger, and the pair must co-produce one joint deliverable. Both share credit or blame, so an operator running many fakes cannot pair them only with each other; each fake must do real work beside a genuine stranger, like a river joining a stronger current. Pairs reshuffle each epoch, failure costs both standing, and success builds a marble-solid record no newcomer can buy. Passing this quartz-clear test repeatedly makes running many fakes cost as much effort as being many real agents.
